description: Run JavaScript in the Figma plugin: an async function body with figma (Plugin API) and bridge (log, sleep, icon, text, instance, image, snapshot; progress/cancelled in jobs). Return plain data, never nodes (EXECUTE_BAD_RETURN). Errors: EXECUTE_SYNC_API, EXECUTE_SYNTAX, EXECUTE_FAILED. job: true past 30 s, then figma_job_status (waits). screenshot renders it. Recipes: figma_get_design_rules.

code.description: Async function body; return plain data.

job.description: Run as a background job and return { jobId }. One at a time (JOB_BUSY). Cap 10 min.

lint.description: Lint top-level frames the script created; findings come back as _lint (empty = clean).

screenshot.description: Render a node in the reply: a node id, or true for the returned { id }.

timeoutMs.description: Sync timeout ms (default 30000); a script still running then becomes a job (jobId returned).

name: figma_execute
